title: LinkedIn Company Details Scraper (No Cookies)
description: Scrape LinkedIn company details without requiring cookies. Provide company URLs or names — mix and match in the same list.

companies.title: Companies (URLs or Names)
companies.description: Enter LinkedIn company URLs or company names — one per line. URLs like https://www.linkedin.com/company/google will be scraped directly. Plain names like 'Google' or 'Microsoft' will be searched on LinkedIn.

fileName.title: File Name
fileName.description: Tag name for this run. Used to identify your output file. Example: my-target-companies-batch-1
